_readme: TypeScript strategy (handover 2026-09-29): JS codebase with INCREMENTAL typing.
Base pass: structure/syntax check over everything (checkJs off — legacy untyped).
Strict pass: files listed in tsconfig.strict.json are fully type-checked.
Growth rule: every NEW module must be added to tsconfig.strict.json with
// @ts-check + JSDoc types. Run: npm run typecheck (must stay 0 errors).
The company inherits the strict list and converts legacy modules at its pace.
See docs/HANDOVER-2026-09-30.md for the full handover guide.
